unresolved_items.item: An example open item carried on the handoff.

note: Synthetic example that is meant to FAIL validation against HANDOFF_PACKET.schema.json. Every other field is well-formed, so the receiver is the only reason it fails: sdr is leftover-file assigned with no live job, so no work is handed to it. Substituting developer or head-of-engineering fails the same way, on the parked rule. No real client, author, employee, or credential appears here; the identifiers and the date are placeholders.
